description: This file contains code for controlling MCP42010 digital potentiometers, including initialization, configuration, and SPI communication functions.

classes.name: Mcp42010Driver
classes.description: Data structure representing the configuration and state of a MCP42010 digital potentiometer driver

methods.name: initPotentiometer
methods.description: Initializes a MCP42010Driver with SPI configuration and chip select pin

methods.name: getPotStep
methods.description: Computes the potentiometer step value based on resistance in ohms

methods.name: sendToPot
methods.description: Sends a command to set a specific potentiometer channel to a value via SPI

methods.name: setPotResistance
methods.description: Sets the resistance value of a specific potentiometer channel

methods.name: setPotResistanceCommand
methods.description: Sets the resistance of a specific potentiometer channel given an index and value

methods.name: setPotValue1
methods.description: Sets a specific potentiometer channel to a predefined value

methods.name: initPotentiometers
methods.description: Initializes all potentiometers based on configuration, and registers console commands
